timing_scope.batch_window: From run() entry before first integrity/reservation through common parent setup, per-run preparation, source verification, progress and summary analysis. Controller startup/standard-library imports/initial freeze read and final self-publication are outside this batch window and explicitly unmeasured. Each primary child window includes its full startup/import.
timing_scope.cold_scope: Fresh processes with empty application image caches. OS caches untouched.
timing_scope.primary_end: After process exit and full result, PNG, NPZ and trace reads plus image and counter validation.
timing_scope.primary_start: Immediately before Popen, after output directory allocation and frozen hash verification.
